target: Pokémon FireRed, English GBA BPRE revision 0; SHA1 verified
objective: Find the ROM and make its playable presentation photorealistic. First accepted exploration/battle sequence is a production milestone, not proof of full-game completion.
style_formula: Photoreal cinematic reconstruction with recognizable Pokémon silhouettes and expressive proportions. Organic surfaces have fine, restrained biological detail; shells, eyes, masonry and vegetation have distinct physically based responses. Cool blue creature colors contrast with warm earth and muted green scenery. Natural daylight and soft indirect fill reveal form without hiding defects. Use coherent world scale, legible combat silhouettes and three-dimensional geometry that holds up from the exploration and battle cameras.
